findings.description: The Carbon API is deprecated and not supported on modern macOS systems.
The code installs an event handler but does not store the handler reference (`EventHandlerRef`). When removing the handler, it passes `handler`, which is undefined.

The third parameter to `InstallEventHandler` is the number of event types, but the fourth parameter (the event type array) is `nullptr`. This is incorrect and may cause the handler to not work as intended or cause runtime errors.
If `InitializeEventQueue()` fails, the application exits, but if any resources were allocated before, they would not be cleaned up.
The return value of `InstallEventHandler` is not checked. If it fails, the application continues running in an inconsistent state.
